text:
maya: Heads-up — noticed OTLP exporter starts dropping spans under high QPS when the collector is slow. Logs show `queue full, dropping 512 spans`. Anyone else?

ken: Yup, saw similar on canary yesterday. gRPC stream stalls and exporter keeps accepting; memory climbs until the buffer hits the limit.

samir: What are our current exporter knobs? Are we using an unbounded inflight pool?

maya: Defaults today: buffer_size=10000 (per process), max_inflight_rpcs=0 (unbounded), retry max_attempts=5. Snippet:```yaml
exporter:
  otlp:
    protocol: grpc
    buffer_size: 10000
    max_inflight_rpcs: 0
    retry:
      max_attempts: 5
      initial_interval_ms: 200
      max_interval_ms: 5000
```

toni: Unbounded inflight + big in-memory buffer is dangerous under slow collectors. We should apply backpressure to producers instead of buffering forever. Options: cap inflight rpcs (eg 16), expose per-exporter queue_limit with rejection, or spill to disk as a fallback.

ken: Also seeing retry goroutines explode during sustained 5xxs — need a retry budget + bounded concurrency for retries.

maya: Proposal: add two knobs — `inflight_limit` and `queue_capacity`. When queue full, fail fast upstream (return 429) so producers get backpressure. Add a token-bucket `retry_budget` for controlling retry churn. Suggested defaults: inflight_limit=32, queue_capacity=2000, retry_budget=100/min.

observability-bot: Suggested metrics to add: `exporter.queue_fill_pct`, `exporter.inflight_rpcs`, `exporter.retry_budget_remaining`, `exporter.drop_reason{queue|overflow|backend}`.

samir: If we return 429 to the app we surface errors to customers. We should distinguish throttled vs dropped in the response or headers so apps can handle (retry-after vs drop). Add metric tag reason=queue_full vs backend_5xx.

maya: Also consider disk spill for short bursts: spill to encrypted rotating files and resume send when collector recovers. This avoids immediate data loss but increases complexity.

toni: Disk-spill okay but must include encryption, rotation, size cap. Also changes deployment/ops surface area.

ken: For gRPC settings we should lower keepalive and add idle stream detection: `keepalive_time_ms=20000`, `keepalive_timeout_ms=2000`. That helps detect stuck streams faster and trigger reconnection.

maya: Plan: draft PR that adds `inflight_limit`, `queue_capacity`, `retry_budget`, `drop_on_full=true|false` (default true), disk_spill config (disabled by default), and the new metrics. We'll also add unit tests that simulate a slow collector and an e2e perf job to validate no OOM.

samir: +1 on tests. Also add integration test to assert clients get 429 when queue is full.

toni: Rollout UX: make the new defaults behind a feature flag for tenants. Enable in non-prod first, then staged rollout in prod with per-tenant override in the console.

maya: Sounds good. I'll include a small config example and an e2e script in the PR, and document the console flag. Will ping once PR is up :thumbsup:
